definitions.name: S0C.NE
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A B LT NOT A B GT NOT AND NOT
definitions.note: Two operands A B: TRUE where A differs from B, elementwise over vectors.

definitions.name: S0C.OR
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A NOT B NOT AND NOT
definitions.note: Two truth operands A B: their disjunction, built from NOT and AND.

definitions.name: S0C.STARTS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND 0 N 1 SUB RANGE [ 'I' BIND I 0 EQ V I GET V I 1 SUB GET S0C.NE S0C.OR ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector V to the ascending indices where a run of equal values begins (index 0 and every index that differs from its predecessor).

definitions.name: S0C.DEDUP
definitions.note: Vector V with each run of equal adjacent values collapsed to its first value.

definitions.name: S0C.RLE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V S0C.STARTS 'S' BIND V S GET S 1 DROP V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT S SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Vector V to run-length pairs [ value count ], one per maximal run of equal adjacent values.

definitions.name: S0C.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV FLOOR D MUL N EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Positive integer N to the ascending vector of its divisors.

definitions.name: S0C.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ S0C.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Positive integer N to the ascending vector of primes up to N (a prime has exactly two divisors).

definitions.name: S0C.PASS
definitions.note: One pass that deletes every adjacent matched pair () and [] from a String.

definitions.name: S0C.RED6
definitions.body: S0C.PASS S0C.PASS S0C.PASS S0C.PASS S0C.PASS S0C.PASS
definitions.note: Reduces a bracket String by six passes, enough for at most twelve characters; the result is the String left after all matched pairs are removed.
